step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays an automated compliance remediation workflow (CloudBots) triggered by Dome9 and AWS GuardDuty. 1. Dome9 (ThirdParty) and GuardDuty (GuardDuty) both send findings/notifications to an input SNS topic (SNS). 2. The input SNS topic triggers a centralized CloudBots Lambda function (Lambda). 3. The Lambda function parses the event and executes remediation actions across target AWS accounts (Account 1, Account 2 represented as VPC nodes). 4. After remediation, Lambda logs/publishes results to an output SNS topic (SNS). 5. The output SNS topic sends notification alerts to external tools like Email and Slack (ThirdParty).
